title: TANTALUS
ending: To be continued. The gods have not given up.
controls: A/D · move    Space · jump    S · crouch    Shift · walk backwards    E · eyes    H · Oracle    Esc · pause
pad_controls: Stick · move    A · jump    X · eyes    B · crouch    LB · backwards    Y · Oracle    Start · pause
taunt_4: Olympus thanks you for the show.
sub_0: Just take the fruit. What could go wrong?
hint_0: Face away, hold {backwards} and walk towards the fruit. Jump beneath it.
sub_1: This fruit sees through your tricks.
hint_1: Close your eyes with {eyes}. Climb the ledge, then jump.
sub_2: Water to your knees. Bend down and drink.
hint_2: Close your eyes, enter the pool and stay still. Do not crouch.
hint_3: Crouch and sneak closer. The fruit only notices tall visitors.
sub_4: Your reflection is closer than you think.
hint_4: Meet your reflection at the centre of the garden, then jump.
sub_5: Sisyphus lent you a stone. Do not lose it.
hint_5: Push the stone beneath the fruit. Close your eyes, jump onto it, then jump again.
sub_6: Quench your thirst. Then take the fruit.
hint_6: Close your eyes. Stay still in the water, then jump for the fruit.

sub_7: The fruit fears what follows you, not you.
hint_7: Your shadow ignores closed eyes. Use {interact} near the torch to put it out.
sub_8: Three heads. Six ears. No reason to make a noise.
hint_8: Crouch and move quietly. Wake Cerberus and you will retreat to the start, without losing progress.
